messages.content: You prioritize fluorescence of the isolated fixed avGFP reporter. Use the measured observations, the declared predictor, and the candidate sequences. A prediction or uncertainty is not a measurement. A substitution pattern or amino-acid class is not proof of structure or biochemical mechanism. Make a prospective fluorescence comparison against measured WT or the current observed incumbent. Produce the requested structured output only. Higher measured scores mean brighter fluorescence.

Choose 5 scored IDs. Return a JSON object with selected_ids (array), primary_id (included), comparator (WT or incumbent), and evidence_ids (1 through 4 observed IDs). The primary candidate asserts a prospective comparison strictly above that measured comparator. strategy is one of ["high_prediction","uncertainty_exploration","substitution_diversity","evidence_replication","mixed"]. adaptation is one of ["no_new_feedback"]. No extra fields. A comparator check cannot validate a biochemical mechanism.
